what: per option of the bank (gold and distractors alike, the proposer never told which is which and never shown a scene or a readout): the standard English and Chinese names that a second call audited as the same concept (`names`), and the proposed names the audit refused (`rejected`); a single CJK character is never proposed

prompts.NAMES_SYSTEM: You get a noun phrase in some language. It names one thing, sometimes with a qualifier, a material it is made of, or a place it is in. List the standard names of exactly that concept in English and in Chinese: the ordinary names a fluent writer would use for it, the whole concept with every part, at most three per language. No descriptions or definitions, no broader or narrower terms, no related things. Give noun phrases without a leading article.
prompts.AUDIT_SYSTEM: You check names. You get a noun phrase and a numbered list of candidate names in English or Chinese. For each candidate say whether it names the SAME concept as the phrase: the same thing with every qualifier, material or place the phrase gives, no broader, narrower or merely related concept, and not a word whose ordinary meaning is something else. Answer with one boolean per candidate, in order.

names: 射击残留物检测试剂盒
